metric.name: frame_p95_ms
metric.sql_used:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY upid ORDER BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT dur AS ns, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY dur) AS rank, count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM frames
  )
SELECT (SELECT ns / 1e6 FROM ranked WHERE rank = (n * 95 + 99) / 100) AS value

claims.text: The selected end-to-end UI frame p95 improved from 76.544292 ms in baseline to 73.255125 ms in current, a delta of -3.289166999999992 ms; this metric does not show a regression.

caveats: There is only one capture per side, so the 3.289 ms p95 difference may be run-to-run noise.
The current run is an emulator benchmark capture; device scheduling and SurfaceFlinger variability can affect these measurements.
Binder wait should be investigated separately with repeated captures if binder latency, rather than frame delivery, is the target metric.

dropped_claims.text: Whole-trace synchronous binder wait is a contrary signal, increasing from 287.81833 ms to 348.319381 ms, but it is a separate aggregate metric and does not establish a frame-time regression.

citations.sql:
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.binder;
INCLUDE PERFETTO MODULE android.frames.timeline;
WITH
  window_frames AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.upid, f.ui_thread_utid, a.id, a.dur, a.jank_type
    FROM android_frames_layers AS f
    JOIN actual_frame_timeline_slice AS a ON a.id = f.actual_frame_timeline_id
    WHERE f.layer_name NOT GLOB '*SurfaceView*' AND a.dur > 0
  ),
  app AS (
    SELECT upid FROM window_frames GROUP BY count(*) DESC, upid LIMIT 1
  ),
  frames AS (
    SELECT * FROM window_frames WHERE upid = (SELECT upid FROM app)
  )
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM frames)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM android_binder_txns) THEN NULL
    ELSE coalesce((
      SELECT sum(client_dur) FROM android_binder_txns
      WHERE is_sync AND client_dur > 0
        AND client_utid IN (SELECT ui_thread_utid FROM frames)
    ), 0) / 1e6
  END AS value
